narrative.overview: Career-Ops Studio merges the raw, structural authority of architectural blueprints with the surgical, side-by-side diffing clarity of high-performance text editors. It rejects the mushy, pastel-tinted sameness of consumer AI applications in favor of high-contrast conviction: stark white cards set against a warm zinc paper grid, bound by uncompromising 3px solid cobalt blue borders and sharp 6px hard geometric drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Architectural Neo-Brutalism: Heavy 3px cobalt borders, 6px unblurred drop shadows, and subtle 24px blueprint graph grids.
Natural Inline Flow: Diff highlights wrap smoothly across prose without awkward block wrapping, orphan commas, or ragged text gaps.
High-Density Typography: Uppercase black display headings paired with readable 15px body prose and precision JetBrains Mono data labels.
Three-Act Narrative Structure: A guided, purposeful progression (Intake & Lock -> Studio Canvas -> Audit & Export).

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows are strictly geometric offsets (box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px #1414b8), never blurred.

rules.name: The Inline Highlight Rule
rules.body: Highlighted wording must use pure inline styling (box-decoration-break: clone; display: inline;). Never use inline-block.

rules.name: The Left-Justified Rhythm Rule
rules.body: All comparative prose must be strictly left-aligned with matching leading-7 vertical rhythm across both columns.

dos: Do use box-decoration-break: clone; display: inline; for all text highlights.
Do attach punctuation immediately to highlighted phrases without leading spaces.
Do maintain a strict 3px solid #1414b8 border with 6px hard drop shadows on primary containers.
Do give diff cards at least 500px of horizontal breathing room.
donts: Don't use display: inline-block on text highlights; it breaks natural sentence flow.
Don't introduce blurred or semi-transparent drop shadows; all shadows must be 100% hard geometric offsets.
Don't use dark mode or cyberpunk gradients; the canvas is strictly a warm architectural paper blueprint (#fafafa).
Don't squeeze diff columns into three equal widths; the diff is the hero and requires 70% of the viewport.
